in_marathi.name: Ihita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ihita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ihita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ih' meaning 'sun' and 'ita' meaning 'rays'. This name is a representation of the sun's rays spreading light and warmth.
